parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO loan_products (
  lender_name, product_name, source_url,
  interest_rate_min, interest_rate_max, interest_rate_basis,
  loan_amount_min, loan_amount_max, age_min, age_max,
  min_credit_score, max_credit_score, eligible_employment,
  min_monthly_income_rules, processing_fee, eligibility_criteria, raw_criteria,
  min_monthly_income, has_qualitative_rules, source, is_active, stored_at
)
SELECT
  p.lender_name, p.product_name, p.source_url,
  p.interest_rate_min, p.interest_rate_max, p.interest_rate_basis,
  p.loan_amount_min, p.loan_amount_max, p.age_min, p.age_max,
  p.min_credit_score, p.max_credit_score, p.eligible_employment,
  p.min_monthly_income_rules, p.processing_fee, p.eligibility_criteria, p.raw_criteria,
  p.min_monthly_income, p.has_qualitative_rules, 'crawl', TRUE, NOW()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ $json.sqlEscapedJson }}'::jsonb) AS p(
  lender_name TEXT, product_name TEXT, source_url TEXT,
  interest_rate_min NUMERIC, interest_rate_max NUMERIC, interest_rate_basis TEXT,
  loan_amount_min NUMERIC, loan_amount_max NUMERIC, age_min INT, age_max INT,
  min_credit_score INT, max_credit_score INT, eligible_employment TEXT[],
  min_monthly_income_rules JSONB, processing_fee JSONB, eligibility_criteria TEXT, raw_criteria JSONB,
  min_monthly_income NUMERIC, has_qualitative_rules BOOLEAN
)
ON CONFLICT (lender_name, product_name, source_url)
DO UPDATE SET
  interest_rate_min = EXCLUDED.interest_rate_min,
  interest_rate_max = EXCLUDED.interest_rate_max,
  interest_rate_basis = EXCLUDED.interest_rate_basis,
  loan_amount_min = EXCLUDED.loan_amount_min,
  loan_amount_max = EXCLUDED.loan_amount_max,
  age_min = EXCLUDED.age_min,
  age_max = EXCLUDED.age_max,
  min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
  max_credit_score = EXCLUDED.max_credit_score,
  eligible_employment = EXCLUDED.eligible_employment,
  min_monthly_income_rules = EXCLUDED.min_monthly_income_rules,
  processing_fee = EXCLUDED.processing_fee,
  eligibility_criteria = EXCLUDED.eligibility_criteria,
  raw_criteria = EXCLUDED.raw_criteria,
  min_monthly_income = EXCLUDED.min_monthly_income,
  has_qualitative_rules = EXCLUDED.has_qualitative_rules,
  stored_at = NOW(),
  is_active = TRUE;
